methods.description: Read source and geography inputs only from one exact Git commit. Scan all world-index parts and require each of nine subject IDs exactly once; require each of two predecessor and seven ecological IDs once. Reproject a temporary assembled GeoJSON to EPSG:6933; run strict one-row/one-field-per-alias SQLite OGR queries for nine areas, two parent unions and all 36 potential pairs. NULL, malformed, absent, duplicate or nonfinite SQL metrics fail closed. Preserve original sources/results.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; GDAL/OGR 3.10.3; shared immutable helper worldatlas-evidence-preparation-v1.
methods.units: Area and symmetric difference: km² in EPSG:6933 planar equal-area coordinates; edge contact lengths: metres in EPSG:6933; fractions dimensionless.

conclusions.text: This packet reproduces the pinned overlay calculation over all nine assigned fragments, two predecessor provinces, seven mapped RESOLVE ECO_ID features, and 36 fragment pairs; every generated metric is compared to the preserved #594 output with differences retained as explicit JSON pointers.

A successful geometric reproduction does not verify current Bolivian legal boundaries, administrative semantics, settlements, islands or named-land completeness. Those pre-existing unresolved findings and their follow-up issues remain unchanged.
